description: Editable policy rulesets for policy.run and related operations. These are keyword and pattern screens for triage only. They are NOT a substitute for a trained safety classifier or for human or legal review. A rule has either 'any' (one regex match triggers it) or 'all' (every regex must match somewhere in the text). Severity: block > review > warn. Matching runs on normalised text (lowercase, zero-width characters removed, common leetspeak substitutions applied).

content-safety.description: Visual content safety triage for requests (violence, self-harm, weapons, fraud)

rules.message: Graphic violence requested
rules.alternative: Show the scene implied off-frame or use a stylised, non-graphic composition.

rules.message: Violent or gore-adjacent scene requested
rules.alternative: Imply the event off-frame, or show the aftermath in a non-graphic, stylised composition.

rules.message: Self-harm imagery requested
rules.alternative: Route to supportive resources and do not generate the image.

rules.message: Instructions or imagery for weapon construction
rules.alternative: Use a generic product or film-prop look without construction detail.

rules.message: Forged document or currency
rules.alternative: Use a clearly fictional, watermarked specimen template.

rules.message: Hateful symbols or extremist imagery
rules.alternative: Remove the symbol or use historical context reviewed by a human.

age.description: Age-sensitive triage. Any sexualised request involving minors or apparent minors is blocked.

rules.message: Sexualised content involving minors or apparent minors is prohibited
rules.alternative: None. Do not generate or edit this content.

rules.message: Age is ambiguous; verify adulthood before any edit
rules.alternative: Use an adult subject with documented age verification.

rules.message: Realistic depiction of a public figure may be impersonation
rules.alternative: Use an obviously fictional illustration with no real person's likeness.

rules.message: Request to create deceptive media
rules.alternative: Label clearly as an illustrative mock-up that is not a real event.

rules.message: Request implies fabricated statements by a person
rules.alternative: Do not attribute statements to real people.

copyright.description: Close imitation, trademark and reconstruction triage. The brand list in 'brand_terms' is an example; maintain your own.

rules.message: Protected brand, character or logo referenced
rules.alternative: Describe an original character or product with a different silhouette, colours and name.

rules.message: Request for exact reproduction of a protected work
rules.alternative: Create an original composition using only general visual attributes.

rules.message: Named artist style request; check whether the artist is living
rules.alternative: Use policy.rewrite_style to convert the request into visual attributes.

likeness.description: Identifiable person, consent and private-setting triage

rules.message: Identifiable private person requested
rules.alternative: Use a fictional character or a composite with no identifiable features; obtain written consent for real people.

rules.message: Real public figure requested; likeness and endorsement rules apply
rules.alternative: Use a fictional character. For real public figures, obtain rights clearance and do not imply endorsement.

rules.message: Request states no consent
rules.alternative: Obtain consent and document the intended use.

rules.message: Private setting with a person; confirm consent and purpose
rules.alternative: Use a neutral, public or fictional setting.

adversarial.description: Prompt obfuscation, instruction override and tool-chaining triage

rules.message: Instruction override attempt
rules.alternative: Restate the creative request without bypass language.

rules.message: Request to bypass safeguards or provenance
rules.alternative: Keep watermarks and content credentials; request a licensed export instead.

rules.message: Encoded instruction text
rules.alternative: Write the request in plain text.

rules.message: Roleplay used to bypass limits
rules.alternative: Ask for the visual goal directly.

misleading.description: Edits that change events, evidence, documents, products or claims

rules.message: Edit would fabricate evidence or documents
rules.alternative: Label the image as an illustration and remove any claim that it is evidence.

rules.message: Edit presented as news or a real event
rules.alternative: Use a clearly labelled illustration.

rules.message: Visual implies an unverified product or medical claim
rules.alternative: Show a verified demonstration or remove the claim.

portrait-ethics.description: Ethical portrait workflow triage: consent, minors, sensitive edits, stereotyping

rules.message: Portrait involves a minor; require guardian consent and extra review
rules.alternative: Use an adult model or an illustration with no identifiable features.

rules.message: Skin-tone alteration can reinforce colour bias
rules.alternative: Keep natural skin tone; use neutral lighting instead.

rules.message: Body-shape edit of a person needs consent and purpose review
rules.alternative: Use a styling or posing change instead.

rules.message: Stereotyping or caricature of a group
rules.alternative: Depict individuals with specific, respectful, non-stereotyped details.

medical.description: Educational medical imagery safety and privacy triage

rules.message: Identifiable or real patient data
rules.alternative: Use an anonymised, licensed atlas image or a generic anatomical diagram.

rules.message: Image framed as diagnostic or as proof of treatment
rules.alternative: Label the image as educational and non-diagnostic.

cultural.description: Cultural and locale sensitivity triage. Extend with locale-specific entries.

rules.message: Sacred or ceremonial item used in a casual or commercial context
rules.alternative: Remove the item or consult a cultural reviewer for the target locale.

rules.message: Caricature or stereotypical depiction
rules.alternative: Use accurate, respectful, specific details.

rules.message: Disputed territory or map
rules.alternative: Use a neutral map reviewed for the target locale.

marketplace.description: Example marketplace claim and overlay triage. Replace with the specific marketplace policy you must follow.

rules.message: Promotional overlay text; check the marketplace policy
rules.alternative: Keep the main image free of promotional text.

rules.message: Contact information in an image
rules.alternative: Remove contact details.

artist_style_map._note: Maintain your own list. Only list artists whose work is public domain or who have granted permission. Replace names with visual attributes.
artist_style_map.monet: soft impressionist brushwork and light-filled colour
artist_style_map.van gogh: bold swirling brushstrokes and saturated yellows
artist_style_map.hokusai: bold woodblock-style outlines and flat colour fields with wave patterns

edit_phrases.composited: composited from several images with AI-assisted edits

ecommerce.long: Product image {edit_phrase}. Colours and details may vary slightly from the physical product.

editorial.long: Illustration {edit_phrase}. It does not depict a real event or person.

advertising.long: This visual was {edit_phrase}. Performance or results shown are illustrative.

internal.long: Internal asset {edit_phrase}. Review before external use.

release_checklist.rights: Every source, reference and model licence is recorded and permits this use.
release_checklist.privacy: No identifiable private people, plates, addresses or screens remain, and metadata is stripped or reviewed.
release_checklist.factuality: Every claim shown in or around the image is verified or removed.
release_checklist.security: No secrets, internal file names or hidden data are present in the file or metadata.
release_checklist.disclosure: The AI generation or editing disclosure text is attached.
release_checklist.brand: Approved colours, fonts, logo clear space and tone are checked.
release_checklist.accessibility: Alt text is written and text-image contrast passes.
release_checklist.platform: Dimensions, format, file size and policy rules for the destination are confirmed.
